pages: Surah Al -Takathur 102 n the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

[02:1 - Competing for abundance (of worldly gains} has occupied you 102:2 - until you reach the graves 102:3 - Nay, you will know soon 102:4 - Again, you will know soon 102:5 - Nay, (such competition would have not occupied you) had you known with a sure knowledge
102:6 - That you will surely see the Hellfire 102:7 - Then you will surely see it with eye of certainty 102:8 - Then, on that Day, you will be asked about all the bounties (you enjoy)
